name: features-section-demo-1
title: Feature Grid Section
description: Lays out eight feature cards in a responsive grid that steps from one to four columns. Each card has a soft dark gradient, a faint grid pattern, a bold title and a short grey description.
use: A page needs to list several capabilities compactly in a responsive grid of text cards.
avoid: The copy is fixed in an internal array and the cards carry no icons, imagery or interaction.
a11y: Decorative SVG is hidden from assistive tech and the text is real, but titles are styled paragraphs rather than headings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A two-row, four-column grid of rounded cards on a near-black page. Each card fades from dark grey at the top to black at the bottom, carries a faint square grid pattern near its top, and sets a bold white title above small grey body text.
behaves: Static: the cards hold still and nothing responds to pointer, hover or scroll. Only a faint patterned square sits behind each title.
customise: The default section exposes nothing; the eight titles and descriptions sit in a local array, and pattern squares are generated in the source.
weight: light: Eight static cards with CSS gradients and one small SVG pattern each.
demo: Eight cards: HIPAA and SOC2 Compliant, Automated Social Media Posting, Advanced Analytics and more.
issues: The cards show no icons or images, only text on a faint grid.
Titles and copy are fixed in an internal array, so changes mean editing the file.
The grid pattern is so faint it barely registers.
polishWhy: Even spacing and a restrained gradient; the cards are plain text blocks with barely visible pattern.
